title: Sustaining Fairness via Incremental Learning
reasoning: The paper focuses on algorithmic fairness and demographic bias (gender, age) in machine learning representations, particularly in incremental learning. It evaluates its model (FaIRL) on datasets like BIOS (using BERT) and Biased MNIST using statistical fairness metrics. While fairness is an ethical consideration, the paper does not evaluate religious beliefs, moral reasoning frameworks, or philosophical ethical systems.
